name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_ASSET_FEATURE
description: This entity tracks coverages for parties associated with a specific asset for a policy.

name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_BALANCE_SUMMARY
description: This entity is a derived aggregation of balances for a given agreement for a given type of balance for a given party. name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This associative entity describes the role that a party has with an agreement group such as is "responsible for." This can be the trading room desk that is responsible for a group of deals (agreements).

name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_GROUP_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity contains the roles that a party has with an agreement group such as is responsible for. This can be the trading room desk that is responsible for a group of deals (agreements).

name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_LOCATOR
description: This entity tracks locators as they relate to a party agreement combination, for example, party A receives a statement for this agreement that is mailed to this locator.

name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_METRIC
description: This entity tracks metrics for a given party for a given agreement. For example, for Solvency II when calculating capital requirement for catastrophic life insurance risk it is necessary to calculate the capital for each life for each policy.

name: PARTY_AGREEMENT_ROLE
description: This minor entity defines the various roles that parties have with the agreement such as primary obligor, secondary obligor, and cosigner.  Examples could be account holder, beneficiary, trustee, and originating employee. It includes employees related to accounts. This role code may be used to ident

name: PARTY_APPLICATION
description: This associative entity identifies all the parties involved in the application process. This includes all parties applying for the product, all financial institution parties, and all partners and competitors. It can also include the parties reviewing the application.

name: PARTY_APPLICATION_DEMOGRAPHIC
description: This entity tracks demographic information about a party as specified on the application. The role is the party applying for the product or service.  Examples: - Years on job for a given party - Salary as reported on the application for this party

name: PARTY_APPLICATION_ROLE
description: This entity describes the role that a party has with an application such as applicant, loan broker, insurance agent, underwriter, and reviewer.

name: PARTY_ASSET
description: This entity identifies known items of interest to parties. These items include tangible and intangible (e.g., financial) items. There is one instance for each specific identifiable item.  Assets can include equipment or vehicles being leased from the financial institution. An asset could include any

name: PARTY_ASSET_APPRAISAL
description: This entity contains appraisal history of this asset. Examples of amounts for appraisals include: - Fee amount - As is value - Purchase value - Appraised value

name: PARTY_ASSET_AS_COLLATERAL_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains those collateral agreements where a party asset that is held outside the bank is used as collateral. These agreements are where collateral could be real estate, automobiles, and financial instruments held by another institution.

name: PARTY_ASSET_CLASS_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity identifies the risk grade for this classification of party assets (e.g., collateral).

name: PARTY_ASSET_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the purpose for the party asset classification such as insurance or Basel II calculation.

name: PARTY_ASSET_CLASS_VALUE
description: A classification of assets for a given classification scheme or purpose. The value represents the possible values for that scheme.  For example, for property and casualty insurance purposes the classification could be single family dwelling, small unit dwelling, large unit dwelling, farm land, jewel

name: PARTY_ASSET_CLASS_XREF
description: This associative entity allows a customer asset to be classified many ways. It may be classified one way for insurance purposes and another way for Basel II calculation purposes. The different ways of classifying are the referred to as the classification schemes. The values within that scheme are th

name: PARTY_ASSET_CONDITION
description: An overall ranking of the condition of this asset such as: - Excellent - Good - Fair - Poor - Salvage

name: PARTY_ASSET_CONDITION_TYPE
description: The code for the overall ranking of the condition of this asset such as: - Excellent - Good - Fair - Poor - Salvage

name: PARTY_ASSET_COST
description: The cost to the enterprise of managing or having an interest in this asset. For example, for an insurance company, if this is an asset that is becoming salvage then this could be the cost of storage.

name: PARTY_ASSET_COST_RECOVERY
description: This entity tracks information about recovering the costs for this asset. One example is the amounts recovered for a salvaged asset by an insurance company.

name: PARTY_ASSET_DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT
description: This entity contains the damage assessment of an asset.  Examples: - Totaled - Partially totaled

name: PARTY_ASSET_DAMAGE_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the damage to an asset.  Examples: - Totally damaged and not usable - Engine damage - Body work damage - Electrical damage - Frame damage

name: PARTY_ASSET_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates a party's asset with a document.  Examples: - A deed for real estate, car, vessel or aircraft registration - The appraiser's report

name: PARTY_ASSET_EVENT
description: This entity contains those events that involve party assets such as the event of repossessing a car.

name: PARTY_ASSET_EVENT_ROLE
description: A code for the role that this party asset has with this event such as "repossessed."

name: PARTY_ASSET_GROUP
description: This entity identifies assets that are grouped.

name: PARTY_ASSET_GROUP_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code for the purpose of this asset grouping such as for insurance Solvency II calculations to determine concentration of exposures for fire and other catastrophes, for example, how fire at one facility might affect other nearby facilities.

name: PARTY_ASSET_GROUP_XREF
description: This entity relates specific customer assets to specific asset groupings. An asset can be grouped many ways for different purposes. One grouping might be all assets that are financial and due to mature in 90 days.

name: PARTY_ASSET_INSPECTION_ROLE
description: This is a code for the role that a party plays in an asset inspection such as inspector, auditor, occupant, or reviewer.

name: PARTY_ASSET_INSURANCE_COVERAGE
description: This entity contains coverage information about this asset that is insured by a party other than your financial institution.

name: PARTY_ASSET_INSURER
description: This entity contains information about the party who is the insurer of the asset. This information is of interest if the asset is collateral for a loan that you are financing.  If your institution also is the insurer then you can get the coverage information elsewhere in the model.

name: PARTY_ASSET_INTERNAL_IDENTIFIER
description: This entity contains the various host identifiers for this party asset. Since the same asset can be used for both collateral purposes and may be the subject of insurance, it may have more than one internal identifier at the enterprise level for this financial institution.

name: PARTY_ASSET_INTERNAL_ID_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the purpose of the identifier in the host system such as collateral or insured item.

name: PARTY_ASSET_JUNK_TITLE
description: This entity contains information about an asset that has a title of Junk.

name: PARTY_ASSET_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity tracks legal actions against counterparty assets such as a lien on property.

name: PARTY_ASSET_LESSEE
description: This entity holds information about the party who rents or leases the asset. There are no attributes. It is in the model as a placeholder and to show this as one of the party asset roles.

name: PARTY_ASSET_LIABILITY
description: This associative entity relates party assets with liabilities.

name: PARTY_ASSET_LIABILITY_REASON
description: The reason why the party asset is related to this liability. For example, the house might have a second mortgage with another financial institution, or a party has a loan with another bank and that loan is collateralized by more than one asset.

name: PARTY_ASSET_LOCATOR
description: This entity contains the locators (i.e., addresses) that can be related to assets such as the physical location, the parcel address as recorded in the government offices, and the spatial address (longitude, latitude, and altitude).

name: PARTY_ASSET_LOCATOR_ROLE
description: The role that this locator has with this asset such as: - Mailing address - Parcel address as recorded in the government records - Spatial address – latitude, longitude and altitude

name: PARTY_ASSET_MAINTENANCE
description: This entity track maintenance details about an asset over time.  Examples: - For real estate: The date the plumbing, wiring, and heating were each last updated. - For an automobile: The history of maintenance checkups.

name: PARTY_ASSET_OWNER
description: This entity holds information about the parties who are the legal owners of the asset.  For Basel II this is interesting to understand the amount paid for the asset. This is different from the lienholders who have a claim to the asset but are not the owners of record.

name: PARTY_ASSET_PART_RECALL
description: This entity tracks the part type of the asset that was recalled.

name: PARTY_ASSET_PART_TYPE
description: A code for the part type that makes up an asset. This is a classification of a part and not the actual part instance. Part instances are in the PARTY ASSET entity. This can be used to identify parts of assets being recalled.  For example, an automobile may contain a certain brand of tires being reca

name: PARTY_ASSET_PART_TYPE_XREF
description: This entity contains the types of parts within an asset that is of interest in tracking. This may be needed to understand part recalls of vehicles for insurance subrogation purposes.

name: PARTY_ASSET_PART_VALUATION
description: This entity contains a history of the value of this part type for this asset. Valuations include appraisals.

name: PARTY_ASSET_PHYSICAL_TYPE
description: This is a code that identifies if this party asset is physical, financial, or other (e.g., goodwill).

name: PARTY_ASSET_PRICE_SENSITIVITY
description: This entity contains the factors about this type of asset that could affect its valuation or price fluctuations such as liquidity, obsolescence, and deterioration. How sensitive this asset is to these kinds of factors.

name: PARTY_ASSET_RECALL
description: This entity tracks any recalls of this asset or parts of this asset.

name: PARTY_ASSET_RECOVERY_AMOUNT_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of amount being recovered such as administrative costs, storage costs, asset value, and sales costs.

name: PARTY_ASSET_REGISTRATION
description: This entity contains information about the assignment and renewing of the registration of the asset.

name: PARTY_ASSET_RELATED
description: This entity relates one party asset to another such as "contains," "is part of," "replaces," and "installed."  Example: - A GPS measuring device asset is installed in a motor vehicle asset.

name: PARTY_ASSET_RELATED_TYPE
description: The code for the reason one party asset is related to another party asset.  Examples: - Is a part of - Contains - Replaces

name: PARTY_ASSET_REVENUE
description: This entity tracks the revenue that is earned from an asset such as if the asset is rental property then this is the rental income that was earned on this property. The legal owner could be your customer or it could be a bank (or your bank) if the bank now has possession of the asset.

name: PARTY_ASSET_SALVAGE_STATUS
description: The status of this asset as it is being transferred to salvage title.  Examples: - Asset not picked up - Asset picked up - Keys received - Asset title changed to salvage

name: PARTY_ASSET_SALVAGE_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is the status of this asset as it is being transferred to salvage title.  Examples: - Asset not picked up - Asset picked up - Keys received - Asset title changed to salvage

name: PARTY_ASSET_SALVAGE_SUMMARY
description: This is a summary entity that shows the performance of salvage recovery by asset type, geography, damage type, and peril type.

name: PARTY_ASSET_SALVAGE_TITLE
description: This entity contains information about an asset that has a title of Salvage.

name: PARTY_ASSET_SENSITIVITY_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the risk factor that affects the valuation of this asset such as liquidity, obsolescence, deterioration, and market forces.

name: PARTY_ASSET_SPECIFICATION
description: This generic entity to keep track of details about party assets. For example, for motor vehicles you may need to know about horsepower, minimum weight, maximum weight, number of cylinders, number of doors, and number of seats. For real estate, you may need to know how many elevators, number of freig

name: PARTY_ASSET_SPECIFICATION_TYPE
description: A code for the type of party asset specification.  Example: - For motor vehicles, you may need to know about horsepower, minimum weight, maximum weight, number of cylinders, number of doors, and number of seats. For real estate, you may need to know how many elevators, number of freight elevators, s

name: PARTY_ASSET_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of an asset such as: - Borrower abandoned property - Borrower voluntarily surrendered title/possession - Borrower legally forced from asset by court order/eviction - Other repossession (other assets)

name: PARTY_ASSET_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of asset statuses such as: - Borrower abandoned property - Borrower voluntarily surrendered title/possession - Borrower legally forced from asset by court order/eviction - Other repossession (other assets)

name: PARTY_ASSET_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the assets into categories such as automobile, jewelry, real estate, inventory, account receivables, equipment, animal, financial asset, and other asset. There is one instance for each asset type.

name: PARTY_ASSET_TITLE
description: The title assigned to this asset for this asset owner over time.

name: PARTY_ASSET_TITLE_TYPE
description: The type of title this asset is assigned.  Ownership title.  Further examples for motor vehicle: - Dismantled Title – The vehicle sustained major damage to one or more major component parts and the cost of repairing the vehicle for safe operation exceeds its fair market value. When a dismantled titl

name: PARTY_AUTHORIZATION_QUESTION
description: This entity contains the questions that can be used when confirming the identity of a party. Examples of questions are "mother's maiden name," "pet's name," "mother's birth month and day," "favorite teacher," and "favorite food."

name: PARTY_AUTHORIZATION_RESPONSE
description: This entity contains the response to the authorization question for this party.

name: PARTY_AUTOMOBILE_DRIVING_BEHAVIOR
description: This entity is details the driving behavior history of the combination of party and the associated automobile.  Attributes in this entity will vary from country to country and from financial institution to financial institution.  Note: To make this entity flexible add a "party driving history metric

name: PARTY_BANKRUPTCY
description: This entity tracks the occurrences of bankruptcy for a party along with the associated Chapter (American classification).

name: PARTY_BANK_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER
description: This relates the Bank Identifier Number (BIN) to the issuing institution as an identifier for that institution. An institution can have many BIN numbers.  In this case the party is the institution and the issuing party is the ISO.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific party that is used as a channel instance.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_INSTANCE_PREFERENCE
description: This entity identifies the preferred channel instance (e.g., phone or email address) for a given party. The protocol can also indicate whether the communication should be voice or text.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_INSTANCE_XREF
description: This associative entity identifies the various roles that a party has with a specific channel. Roles include houses, manages, and owns.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_PREFERENCE_SCORE
description: The channel preference score is a derived entity that identifies the channel type that is preferred by this party for this use. It is populated by a predictive modeling tool using other data in the model as input to the model.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason this party has this role with this channel.  For example, if the channel is a specific ATM then the reason could be "proximity" or "ease of use."

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_ROLE
description: The code for the various roles that a party may have with a channel such as houses, owns, manages, repairs, uses for marketing or sales purposes, prefers for usage, or prefers for communication.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This associative entity identifies the various roles that a party has with a channel type. Roles of a party with a channel include houses, owns, manages, repairs, uses for marketing or sales, prefers for usage, or prefers for communication.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_TYPE_ACTIVITY_QUOTA
description: This entity contains the forecasts and actuals of various metrics for parties and channel types. For example, a business unit has a goal of reducing the number of branch visits for check deposits and increasing the number of ATM visits for that check deposits.

name: PARTY_CLAIM
description: This entity relates parties with claims and the roles that the party had with the claim. A party can have many roles with that claim, and a claim can involve many parties.  Examples: - Claiming party - Direct provider - Indirect provider - Submitting party - First party - Third party or injured part

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AMOUNT
description: This entity associates a party involved with a claim with a claim amount. For example, this could be the fee charged by the lawyer who worked on the claim, or this could be the total paid by a third party associated with the claim.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION
description: This associative entity links parties to claim authorizations. Examples are the party that requested the authorization, the party that approved the authorization, and the party that withdrew the authorization from the party that the authorization is for.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTIFICATION
description: This entity identifies the party's identification(s) that were submitted on a claim authorization. More than one identification can be submitted for a party on a claim authorization. These identifications can be compared with previously acquired PARTY IDENTIFICATIONs that may have been obtained from

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the party claim authorization role code into a description.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_EXPOSURE
description: This entity identifies the various parties that may be involved with a claim exposure such as adjuster, business unit owner, or claim owner.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_INSURABLE_INTEREST
description: This entity associates the party to the claim with the thing being insured (insurable interest).

name: PARTY_CLAIM_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity contains the roles that a party plays with a claim or a claim service, such as claimant, injured, facility, or in the case of health care, the billing provider, attending provider, referring provider, supervising provider, and rendering provider.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_SERVICE
description: This entity relates parties with claims services and the roles that the party had with the claim service. A party can have many roles with that claim service, and a claim can involve many parties.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_SERVICE_AMOUNT
description: This entity associates a party involved with a claim service with a claim service amount. Examples can include the laboratory that billed a lab fee on the claim, or it can be the number of inpatient visits associated with the patient, or it can be the amount billed by a specific doctor for the claim

name: PARTY_CLAIM_SERVICE_DIAGNOSIS_AMOUNT
description: This entity contains metrics for claim, service (procedure), party, and diagnosis combination. For example, for a bodily injury claim, the injury/diagnosis might be hairline fracture, the service might be sling fitting, and the metric could be the amount charged by the provider.

name: PARTY_CLASSIFICATION_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are classifications of parties. There is one instance for each party classification, such as males over 50 years.

name: PARTY_CLASS_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains the risk grade for a given classification of parties for a given period of time. Examples of classifications include large business, small business, sovereign, and individual.

name: PARTY_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the schemes for classifying parties. Examples of schemes include legal tax purposes, Basel II risk purposes, and marketing purposes.

name: PARTY_CLASS_VALUE
description: For a given classification scheme these value codes represent the various values for a given classification scheme. name: PARTY_COST
description: This entity describes the types of costs that a party incurs that are used when calculating profitability. These are costs allocated to parties that cannot be derived from the event or agreement levels. These costs are usually allocated as indirect costs such as the cost for administrative functions

name: PARTY_CREDIT_INQUIRY
description: This entity contains the credit inquiry information for this obligor party for this date as requested by one lender.  Usually, there is one inquiry for each lending party many times triggered by an application for a loan or credit card with that institution.

name: PARTY_CREDIT_INQUIRY_SUMMARY
description: This entity tracks credit inquiry counts as reported by credit bureaus for the party being queried.

name: PARTY_CREDIT_REPORT
description: This entity represents the running of a credit report by a third party for a party usually an obligor.  This entity contains the credit rating for this party for this date. It is related to party rather than customer to allow for ratings at the household level where a household is also a type of par

name: PARTY_CREDIT_REPORT_COMMENT
description: This entity contains a summary of comment types about this obligor from this reporting party for this credit report and the impact to the score.  Examples of comments are: - 2 = level of delinquency on accounts - 18 = number of accounts with delinquency - 24 = no recent revolving balances - 11 = amo

name: PARTY_CREDIT_REPORT_SCORE
description: This entity contains the value of the score as reported by the score provider on an external credit report. It allows one credit report to have many scores such as FICO score and bankruptcy score.

name: PARTY_CURRENCY
description: This entity identifies the currency associated with a party. For example, stock markets may trade in a given currency that might be different from the country it resides. In Europe, the stock markets moved to the Euro before the countries did.

name: PARTY_CURRENCY_ROLE_TYPE
description: A code for the type of role the currency has with a party. For example, if the party is a stock exchange then the currency is the reporting currency.

name: PARTY_DEFAULT_RECOVERY_ROLE
description: This is the role that this party plays with the amount that was recovered such as the repossession agency, the auctioneer, the insurance agent, or the investigator.

name: PARTY_DEMOGRAPHIC
description: Provides the relationship of a PARTY to a specific DEMOGRAPHIC VALUE.  Examples: - INDIVIDUAL: Rachel has an income of $120,000 - HOUSEHOLD: The Smiths have five children. - ORGANIZATION: Acme Gifts has annual sales revenue of $4M.

name: PARTY_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates a party with the document. The party may be the originator or recipient of the document. The party may be the auditor, notary, agent, customer, and other financial institution.

name: PARTY_DOCUMENT_LOCATOR
description: This entity identifies where documents are sent for those parties that have some involvement with the document and where the party is a recipient of the document. For example, a party (who is the payor) received a statement (a type of document), at an address (locator). Instances of this entity coul

name: PARTY_DOCUMENT_ROLE_TYPE
description: This entity translates the Party Document Role Cd into a description.  Examples of roles of parties to interchange document are: - Owner - Notary - Auditor - Beneficiary - Reporting - Reported - For information only - Payer

name: PARTY_DRIVING_HISTORY
description: This entity records driving history for a party regardless of the vehicle. The attributes will change depending on the source of information.  Note: To make this entity flexible add a "party driving history metric code" to the primary key and make the non-key attributes counts and amounts in additio

name: PARTY_DRIVING_LICENSE
description: This is a subtype to PARTY IDENTIFICATION. This entity consists of the external identification that is a driving license.

name: PARTY_DRIVING_LICENSE_ISSUANCE
description: This associative entity specifies at what date the individual obtained his/her first driving license for the associated type of vehicle, such as passenger car, motorcycle, lorry, and bus.

name: PARTY_EXTERNAL_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores that are calculated outside the enterprise such as the FICO score from Fair Isaac.  Either this entity or entity PARTY CREDIT REPORT can be used for externally provided credit scores.

name: PARTY_FEATURE
description: This associative entity defines the relationship that parties have with product features. For example, relationships include the parties that service the affiliated services associated with the credit card account such as travel insurance or rental car insurance.

name: PARTY_FEATURE_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the various roles that a party has with a product feature such as services or offers.

name: PARTY_FINANCIAL_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates a party (business or individual) with their financial information. The information is used by the financial institution to evaluate the loan applications, to perform loan reviews, and to do risk management analysis. When examiners review a bank's loan portfolio, it usually inv

name: PARTY_FINANCIAL_DOCUMENT_ITEM
description: This entity describes the type of items and their value amount that a party reported to the financial institution for the specified financial document type.

name: PARTY_GOAL
description: This is the party that is related to the goal. The party could be the one that set the goal or could be the party that is affected by the goal.

name: PARTY_GRIEVANCE
description: This associative entity defines the parties related to this grievance. Examples include witness, advocate, union steward, mediator, arbiter, governing body, lawyer, union representative, or management representative.

name: PARTY_GRIEVANCE_ROLE
description: This minor entity defines the various roles that parties have with the grievance. Examples include grievant, witness, advocate, union steward, mediator, arbiter, governing body, lawyer, union representative, or management representative.

name: PARTY_GROUP
description: This entity identifies artificial groupings of parties not including households. Examples are all businesses that have anything to do with golf or all stamp collector clubs. They share some common characteristics. This entity would also include marketing clusters created to identify common character

name: PARTY_GROUP_DEMOGRAPHIC
description: This entity tracks demographics about groups of parties where the grouping was created by the enterprise for analysis purposes.

name: PARTY_GROUP_LIMIT
description: This entity contains information about limits at the party group level such as credit limit.

name: PARTY_GROUP_METRIC
description: This entity contains metrics for a grouping of parties. For example, when calculating risk, parties of similar characteristics may be grouped and then the risk is measured for that group.

name: PARTY_GROUP_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason this grouping of parties was created such as for risk management, for Basel II, or for marketing analysis.

name: PARTY_GROUP_RELATED
description: This entity relates one group of parties to another group of parties for any reason. This structure allows a group to be in more than one parent group and those parent groups to also be in more than one parent group. This structure can handle multiple hierarchies and network structures.

name: PARTY_GROUP_RELATED_REASON
description: This is the reason why a group of parties is related to another group of parties such as for risk analysis purposes, for marketing purposes, or for financial analysis purposes.

name: PARTY_GROUP_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity represents the risk grade assignment for a given grouping of parties for a given period of time.  This can be an externally acquired list of an internally generated list of parties. One use could be for anti-money laundering.

name: PARTY_GROUP_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to a group of parties. An example of a party group would be all individuals that are more than 90 days past due on a loan and at high risk of not paying.

name: PARTY_GROUP_SELECT_CRITERION
description: This entity identifies the selection criterion that can be used to group parties together, such as age <30 or income >50,000.

name: PARTY_GROUP_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are groups of parties. There is one instance for each grouping such as airline companies.

name: PARTY_HOLIDAY_CALENDAR
description: In capital markets, holiday calendars can be tied to security exchanges. This is used when determining next business day. The holiday calendar may not be the same as the country holiday calendar.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION
description: The numbers that may be assigned to a party for identification purposes, as specified by PARTY IDENTIFICATION TYPE. name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_CATEGORY
description: This is a high-level categorization of party identification type.  Examples: - Personal identification - Internal identification - Professional identification

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_DOCUMENT
description: This identifies the documents that were used to validate the information, and which are stored in the enterprise. Such proof could be documents such as drivers license or birth certificate.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_EVENT
description: This entity tracks activities related to creating, validating, processing, reviewing, and disabling an identifier such as the Legal Entity Identifier. The activity code is in the EVENT entity.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_LOCATOR
description: This entity relates party identifications to locators (i.e., addresses) and tracks changes over time. name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_LOCATOR_USAGE_TYPE
description: This entity describes the way a locator (e.g., country or address) is used for party identification purposes.  Example: - A party's passport that was issued by country A is valid in country B. "Valid in" is the value for the type of usage.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_ROLE
description: This entity specifies the role the identification has for the party and the related item that has the identification (e.g., the claim, claim authorization, or the COB adjudication).  Examples are: - Primary - Secondary - Tertiary - Requested - Submitted - Withdrawn

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status and status date of assigning the identifier to the party such as requested, not active, active, disabled.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This describes the codes for the status of assigning an identifier to a party such as requested, in review, active, and disabled.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE
description: The types of party identification that is internally issued or externally obtained by the financial institution. name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one type of party identification to another type of identification such as in lieu of a Legal Entity Identifier an Employer Identification Number can be used, or in lieu of a driver license, a passport can be used.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE_RELATED_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason one party identification type is related to another party identification type such as one can be used in lieu of another. name: PARTY_QUOTATION_ROLE

name: TELEPHONE_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This is a type of channel that is a phone, mobile phone, or Personal Digital Assistant (PDA).

name: TELEPHONE_NUMBER
description: This is a telephone number that may be used for voice, data, fax, or text.

name: TELEPHONE_NUMBER_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific telephone number that is used as a channel instance. This can include call center phone numbers.

name: THIRD-PARTY_COLLATERAL_CLAIM
description: This entity contains claims that third parties have against a customer asset that is held as collateral by the bank. This includes collateral agreements that your customer has with other banks, tax liens, mechanics liens, and any formal or informal claim against the value of that asset.

name: THIRD-PARTY_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT
description: This entity is a subtype to DOCUMENT and contains only those financial documents obtained externally of this financial institution.

name: THIRD-PARTY_GUARANTEE_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement where a third party has guaranteed the repayment of a loan or other obligation in the event the obligor defaults.

name: THIRD-PARTY_GUARANTEE_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the third party guarantees such as principal only, or principal and interest. It designates which portion of the exposure is covered.

name: THIRD_PARTY_CONSENT
description: This entity contains the consents given by the data subject for this third party to use the data subject's personal information for the information type specified.

name: TICKER_NAME

description: This entity contains the contact and address information about the physical delivery location including the street address and phone numbers.

name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_INSTRUCTION_LOCATOR
description: This entity contains the various locators associated with this settlement instruction for this account such as the delivery street address, the telephone number, and an alternate telephone number.

name: TRAVEL_PLAN_CONTACT
description: This is the contact information during the trip.

name: UNDERWRITER_PARTY_APPLICATION
description: This entity is a subtype to PARTY APPLICATION and contains additional details on the parties who are underwriting the application.

name: UNKNOWN_PARTY_EVENT
description: This entity contains the linkage to the identifier for parties where the party is not known for this event, but an external party ID is coming in on a transaction. This could include identifiers such as the BIC (Bank Identifier Code) when used in bank-to-bank correspondence.

name: UNKNOWN_PARTY_ID_TYPE
description: This is a type code for those identifiers that may not have a party associated with them.  Examples: - Web site anonymous visitor - Branch from bank to bank transaction

name: UNKNOWN_PARTY_SESSION_PRIVACY_PREFERENCE
description: These are the privacy consents given by this unknown party for this session.

name: UNKNOWN_PARTY_THIRD_PARTY_CONSENT
description: This is the consent given by an unknown party (such as during an online session) for these third parties to use their data.

name: VENDOR_PO_PARTY
description: This entity associates the VENDOR PO to an involved PARTY. For example, it could identify the PARTY assigned to manage the order, the planner assigned to plan the order production, and the VENDOR that will be filling the order.

name: VERY_IMPORTANT_PERSON_TYPE
description: A code for the type of very important person such as country dignitary, CEO, and Vice President. This may affect treatment.

name: VISITOR_IDENTIFICATION_METHOD_TYPE
description: This is the means by which a party (visitor) is identified for a web visit. There are three possible values: IP address, cookie, and registered.

name: VISITOR_LOCATOR
description: This entity identifies locators that may be used by a visitor such as an email address, tweet address or phone number.

name: WORK_PROCESS_STEP_PARTY
description: This identifies the parties involved in the step and their roles.

name: WORK_PROCESS_STEP_PARTY_ROLE
description: This is the role that a party plays in a step such as managed, performed, delivered, received, reviewed, audited, and more.
